mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may inhibit levonorgestrel metabolism and increase estrogen levels, potentially enhancing estrogenic side effects including thrombotic risk, while levonorgestrel may affect phenelzine efficacy through metabolic or pharmacodynamic mechanisms.
action: Monitor for increased estrogenic effects (thrombosis, hypertension, mood changes); consider alternative contraception or antidepressant; ensure adequate blood pressure and symptom monitoring if combined use is necessary.
